name: Braced Against All (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +5

Benefit(s): You may use a weapon with the brace special weapon feature against foes who have moved at least 10 ft. before attacking you with a melee attack, whether or not they charged.

Normal: You may only brace against charging foes.
